tip.links: {count} links — click to list, right-click for a menu

status.unconfigured: Not synced — set the CalDAV server in the plugin settings

error.auth: CalDAV login failed — check username and password
error.bad_host: Server URL must start with http:// or https://
error.calendar_no_todos: Calendar "{name}" does not accept todos (enable VTODO on it)
error.no_endpoint: No CalDAV endpoint found on the server
error.no_home: Server did not report a calendar home
error.no_todo_calendar: No calendar accepts todos — enable VTODO on one (Davis: edit calendar → Todos)
error.rejected: Server rejected the todo — does the calendar accept VTODO?
error.open_link: Cannot open {url} (no xdg-open or gio found)

host.label: Server URL
host.description: CalDAV server, e.g. https://davis.example.com. A URL with a path (e.g. …/dav/) is used as the DAV root as-is.

password.label: Password
password.description: CalDAV password. Stored in plain text in Noctalia's settings; ignored when a password file is set.

password_file.label: Password file
password_file.description: File containing the password (e.g. a sops-nix secret). Takes precedence over the password field.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Calendar name or path segment to use. Empty picks the first calendar that accepts todos.

sync_interval.label: Sync interval (seconds)
sync_interval.description: How often to pull changes from the server.

show_count.label: Show count
show_count.description: Show the number of open todos next to the glyph.

show_completed.label: Show completed tasks
show_completed.description: Keep done todos in the panel (struck through, below the open ones).

hint.list: ↑/↓ move · Space done/undone · Enter open link · ↑ on the first todo to add
